name: io.github.amgallego8/colab-mcp
title: Colab-MCP (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for Google Colab: runtimes, code, long jobs, files and notebooks.

environmentVariables.name: COLAB_MCP_WORKDIR
environmentVariables.description: The only local folder the server reads and writes. Defaults to the current directory.

environmentVariables.name: COLAB_MCP_DRIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the optional Google Drive tools (they need a one-time sign-in, see the README).
